2000	But through man's devekut to the Infinite, where there is no change of essence, because
2001	there it is a simple will.
2002	What is simple?
2003	That it has no levels within it, that it is a whole, a complete thing.
2004	And afterwards reshimot remain from that unity, and afterwards it becomes the aspect of
2005	"and returns."
2006	That is, it returns to its own essential will.
2007	But what?
2008	It returns with a charge, with the correction that it made.
2009	Then the reshimot show it to know that everything is good and everything is one.
2010	So I need both of these forces: on one hand I need the expansion from the essential will,
2011	that is, to be bestowing, which is the form of the Infinite, blessed be He, from our standpoint,
2012	in the highest form there is.
2013	Therefore the Arichut of the Infinite also, it is written, wanted to equate the Torah
2014	to His essence. What is "His essence"?
2015	It has no grasp of His essence, but rather the intention: it wanted the form of bestowal as the Infinite appears toward it.
2016	So through our
2017	wanting the power of the infinite bestowal, but on the other hand
2018	we need this power within the desire to receive, not outside the desire to receive. So
2019	we need both of these forces, both the judgment and the mercy, both the HaVaYaH and Elokim.
2020	And this is truly wondrous; therefore the exiles do not understand this: how can it be that you have a longing,
2021	a desire, but truly to bestow?
2022	How can there be a middle line?
2023	The moments are either left or right; I don't understand what a middle is.
2024	Because truly it is a miracle, a wonder, something that is not logical.
2025	But it is a matter of the masach, and there is much to say about it; it is a very deep
2026	subject.
2027	Deeper than the sea.
2028	But in short, we need both the power of "something" and the power of "nothing."
2029	Both the power of awe and complete self-nullification, but also the power of love.
2030	We fulfill this right now in separate subjects.
2031	In the future to come, it will be in one subject, at one time, in one place, and so on.
2032	Right now we work on it in parts.
2033	But each time a reshimo remains from this part.
2034	And then this reshimo...
2035	More and more, slowly, we will have a whole
2036	picture. And this is what Moshe said to his generation: "You were shown to know that HaShem, He is Elokim,"
2037	because Moshe is the aspect of "nothing," and his generation, who cleaved to him, deserve to know.
2038	But who among us even reaches the aspect of "nothing"?
2039	Who even thinks about this?
